# Client-side JavaScript Scripts

## Overview
Provides interactive client-side functionality for Anshul Patel's personal website, including static site client search indexing with Lunr.js and 3D STL model visualization using Three.js.

## Interface
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:initSTLViewer]`: `initSTLViewer(container)` - Initializes Three.js WebGL scene, camera, lighting, and renders STL model inside the target container element.
- `[assets/js/search.js:showSearchResults]`: `showSearchResults()` - Reads user search input, executes Lunr search query, and populates search results in the DOM.
- `[assets/js/search.js:getIndexData]`: `getIndexData(url, callback)` - Performs an asynchronous XMLHttpRequest GET to fetch search index JSON and passes parsed data to callback.
- `[assets/js/search.js:updatePosts]`: `updatePosts(payload)` - Updates module-level post collections and invokes `buildIndex`.
- `[assets/js/search.js:buildIndex]`: `buildIndex(posts)` - Constructs Lunr search index with title as document reference and content as searchable field.

## Invariants
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:initSTLViewer]`: Target container element must have a non-empty `data-src` attribute; returns immediately if empty or missing.
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:initSTLViewer]`: Target container `clientWidth` and `clientHeight` must both be non-zero for ResizeObserver camera/renderer aspect ratio and projection matrix recalculation.
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:autoInit]`: Container must not have `data-initialized` attribute set to prevent redundant viewer initialization.
- `[assets/js/search.js:getIndexData]`: `readyState` must equal `XMLHttpRequest.DONE` and `status` must be `0` or in range `200-399` before callback receives parsed JSON data.
- `[assets/js/search.js:showSearchResults]`: Raw search query must contain non-whitespace characters after stripping non-alphanumeric characters.
- `[assets/js/search.js:showSearchResults]`: Post object in `relevantPosts` must not be undefined when formatting search result anchor tags.

## Side Effects
- `[assets/js/search.js:getIndexData]`: Dispatches asynchronous `XMLHttpRequest` GET request to `/index.json` upon script execution.
- `[assets/js/search.js:updatePosts]`: Mutates module-scoped variables `posts`, `postsByTitle`, and `searchIndex`.
- `[assets/js/search.js:showSearchResults]`: Mutates `innerHTML` of DOM element with id `list` and writes to console during post rendering.
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:initSTLViewer]`: Appends WebGL canvas element to container, registers continuous `requestAnimationFrame` render loop, registers a `ResizeObserver`, and triggers network download via `STLLoader.load`.
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:initSTLViewer]`: Mutates `container.innerHTML` with red error markup if STL loading encounters a network or parse error.
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:autoInit]`: Sets `data-initialized="true"` DOM attribute on matched `.stl-viewer` containers.
- `[assets/js/stl-viewer.js:autoInit]`: Attaches listener to `DOMContentLoaded` event on `document` if document is currently loading.
